title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Rates Table: Interest Rates, Grace Period and Minimum Payment Figures
content:
The interest and minimum payment figures of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards, by card. Each column is the Marlowe & Finch card of that name.

| | Store Card | Store Card Plus | Store Card Elite | Mastercard | Platinum Mastercard | World Elite Mastercard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Purchase APR (variable, percent) | 34.99 | 34.99 | 34.99 | 31.24 | 31.24 | 27.49 |
| Days the APR is divided by | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Minimum interest charge (USD) | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 |
| Grace period (calendar days) | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |
| Minimum payment floor (USD) | 40.00 | 40.00 | 40.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Minimum payment principal percent | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

## What each figure is

- **Purchase APR** — the variable purchase Annual Percentage Rate applied to the average daily purchase balance.
- **Days the APR is divided by** — the number of days the APR is divided by to obtain the daily periodic rate. The daily periodic rate is the APR, as a fraction, divided by that number of days.
- **Minimum interest charge** — the smallest interest charge assessed in a billing cycle in which any interest is due.
- **Grace period** — the calendar days from the statement closing date to the payment due date, during which new purchases accrue no interest when the previous statement balance was paid in full.
- **Minimum payment floor** — the dollar floor of the minimum payment due, or the full statement balance when that is lower.
- **Minimum payment principal percent** — the percent of the statement balance (excluding the interest and fees of the cycle) included in the minimum payment before the interest and fees are added.

## Figures worked through (hypothetical balances)

| Card | APR | Daily periodic rate |
|---|---|---|
| Store Card, Store Card Plus, Store Card Elite | 34.99 percent | 0.3499 divided by 365, about 0.000959 per day |
| Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard | 31.24 percent | 0.3124 divided by 365, about 0.000856 per day |
| World Elite Mastercard | 27.49 percent | 0.2749 divided by 365, about 0.000753 per day |

A statement dated on the 3rd of a 30-day month carries a payment due date 25 calendar days later, on the 28th. On a Marlowe & Finch Mastercard, 1.00 percent of a hypothetical USD 1200.00 balance is USD 12.00; the minimum payment floor of that card is USD 35.00.
